description: Core totals (revenue, total expenses, total assets) are present.
action: Withhold the score; request the return.
sql: revenue IS NULL OR expenses IS NULL OR assets IS NULL

description: Functional expense split (program / management / fundraising) is present when total expenses are positive.
action: Withhold efficiency pillar; check Part IX of the original return.
sql: exp_total_p9 > 0 AND (exp_program IS NULL OR exp_management IS NULL OR exp_fundraising IS NULL)

description: NTEE activity code is present (needed for peer-group normalisation).
action: Normalise against size band only; classify by hand if material.

description: Latest income and expenditure are present in the register.
action: Exclude from financial metrics; usually a newly registered charity.
sql: latest_income IS NULL OR latest_expenditure IS NULL

description: Revenue is available (needed for carbon intensity).
action: Score without intensity; flag lower coverage (private or non-SEC company).

description: Emissions for the base year 2021 are available (needed for the trend).
action: Score without trend.

description: Total expenses are not negative.
action: Block; check sign convention against the original return.

description: Total assets and liabilities are not negative.
action: Block; check the balance sheet in the original return.

description: Negative total revenue (possible with investment losses, but rare).
action: Keep; read Part VIII before scoring stability.

description: Accounting period lasts 360 to 371 days (short first year or 18-month period otherwise).
action: Annualise flows before computing ratios.

description: The period starts in the stated tax year (tax year 2023 = period beginning in 2023).
action: Block; re-map the return to its correct tax year.

description: Income and expenditure are not negative.
action: Block; check the accounts.

description: USD amounts equal GBP amounts x reference rate (1.28), within 2%.
action: Block; re-run the currency conversion.

description: Reported emissions are not negative.
action: Block.

description: EPA-reported emissions are positive for a plant that Climate TRACE models.
action: Check whether the plant was idle or reports under another facility ID.

description: Program + management + fundraising = total functional expenses (tolerance $1 or 0.5%).
action: Block efficiency pillar; check Part IX line 25.
sql: abs(exp_program + exp_management + exp_fundraising - exp_total_p9) > greatest(1, 0.005 * abs(exp_total_p9))

description: Part IX total expenses = Part I total expenses (tolerance $1 or 0.5%).
action: Block; one of the two totals is wrong.

description: Assets - liabilities = net assets (tolerance $1 or 1% of assets).
action: Block financial-health pillar; check the balance sheet.

description: Revenue is within 0.2x to 5x of the prior year reported on the same return.
action: Keep but cap the stability metric; look for a merger, capital campaign or unit error.
sql: revenue > 0 AND revenue_py > 0 AND (revenue / revenue_py > 5 OR revenue / revenue_py < 0.2)

description: Expenses are within 0.1x to 10x of revenue.
action: Keep; check for a pass-through grant year or an error.
sql: revenue > 0 AND expenses > 0 AND (expenses / revenue > 10 OR expenses / revenue < 0.1)

description: Fundraising expenses in Part I (line 16b) = Part IX column D (tolerance $1 or 1%).
action: Use Part IX; note the inconsistency.

description: Expenditure is within 0.1x to 10x of income.
action: Keep; check the accounts.
sql: latest_income > 0 AND latest_expenditure > 0 AND (latest_expenditure / latest_income > 10 OR latest_expenditure / latest_income < 0.1)

description: Emissions are within 0.33x to 3x of 2021.
action: Hold the score until checked; look for an acquisition, divestment or unit error.

description: Average emissions per facility are at least 25,000 tCO2e (the GHGRP reporting threshold for most sources).
action: Hold the score until checked; verify units (tonnes vs thousand tonnes) and ownership shares.

description: One return per EIN for the tax year.
action: Keep the latest original or amended return; drop the others.
sql: ein IN (SELECT ein FROM t GROUP BY ein HAVING count(*) > 1)

description: The same normalised name is used by more than one EIN.
action: Check whether these are chapters of one network or homonyms.
sql: name_key IN (SELECT name_key FROM t GROUP BY name_key HAVING count(DISTINCT ein) > 1)

description: One row per registered charity number.
action: Keep one row.
sql: registered_charity_number IN (SELECT registered_charity_number FROM t GROUP BY registered_charity_number HAVING count(*) > 1)

description: One SEC registrant is not matched to two different parent names.
action: Merge the parent names or fix the match.
sql: sec_cik IN (SELECT sec_cik FROM t WHERE sec_cik IS NOT NULL GROUP BY sec_cik HAVING count(*) > 1)

description: The return ends less than 3 years before the as-of date.
action: Do not use as current; fetch the latest return.

description: The IRS master file already lists a more recent return than the one used.
action: Refresh when the newer return is published in bulk.

description: Latest accounts end less than 3 years before the as-of date.
action: Do not use as current.

description: The charity is not overdue or in double default on its filings.
action: Lower the transparency signal; check the register entry.

description: E-file revenue = IRS SOI extract revenue for the same organisation (tolerance $1 or 1%).
action: Block; compare both with the original return.
sql: soi_revenue IS NOT NULL AND abs(revenue - soi_revenue) > greatest(1, 0.01 * abs(soi_revenue))

description: E-file total assets = SOI extract total assets (tolerance $1 or 1%).
action: Block; compare with the original return.
sql: soi_assets IS NOT NULL AND abs(assets - soi_assets) > greatest(1, 0.01 * abs(soi_assets))

description: E-file total expenses = SOI extract total functional expenses (tolerance $1 or 1%).
action: Block; compare with the original return.
sql: soi_expenses IS NOT NULL AND abs(expenses - soi_expenses) > greatest(1, 0.01 * abs(soi_expenses))

description: The e-file fiscal period matches the SOI extract fiscal period.
action: Re-join on EIN + fiscal period.
sql: soi_tax_pd IS NOT NULL AND tax_pd <> soi_tax_pd

description: Register income = income in the latest annual return, same period.
action: Use the annual return; report the gap.
sql: (total_gross_income IS NOT NULL AND abs(latest_income - total_gross_income) > 1) OR (fin_period_end_date IS NOT NULL AND latest_acc_fin_period_end_date <> fin_period_end_date)

description: Climate TRACE estimate is within 0.5x to 1.5x of the EPA-reported emissions.
action: Keep the reported figure; log the model gap.

description: EPA parent company and Climate TRACE owner share a name (similarity >= 50).
action: Check ownership in the EPA parent-company file before attributing emissions.

description: A company with an SBTi-validated target does not show emissions up more than 10% since 2021.
action: Not an error; a question for engagement (scope, boundary, timing).
